heading: Run It · rough cut plan (creative director, Nov 9 2026)
label: rough cut
covers: Every lyric prompt, the downbeat its world change lands on, the audio edits. at = the world change (the picture's shot boundary; review stills show the result), sung = the prompt's sung onset, land = the downbeat (bar from the drum-MIDI tempo map). Plan: ROUGHCUT_PLAN.md.
grammar: Each word types into the prompt bar on its sung onset. The world change lands on the first downbeat at or after the line's payoff word (payoff - 0.30 s): in the verses that is the next bar's kick (type, then the band executes it), in the choruses it falls on the word itself. 0.30 s before the land the payoff word lifts out of the bar and flies to what it changes, arriving on the downbeat. Exceptions are named per shot (bridge pairs on beat 3, the stop at bar 20 beat 2).

audio_edits.name: the stop before the first chorus (recommended; A/B in the rough cut)
audio_edits.what: Mix out at bar 20 beat 2 (the song already drops its drums there); vocal stem alone for 'Watch me make it' and the 'Bigger' pickup; the full mix back hard on bar 21 = CH1. 4 ms ramps at the cut, none at the return.

audio_edits.name: the zero-g silence (recommended)
audio_edits.what: Mix out on bar 48 (drums already drop here); vocal stem alone for 'put the car back first' and the 'Bigger' pickup (94.21); the full mix back on bar 49 = CH2, with the car's impact.

audio_edits.name: the crash: dead silence at 'Out of memory.' (her ask)
audio_edits.what: Hard cut of everything on bar 78 (3 ms ramp, so it's a cut, not a click). 151.42-154.36 is pure digital silence (2.94 s). 154.36-155.34 the vocal stem alone: 'Out of memory.' (mute the stem's -60 dB 'time' reverb tail before it). The mix returns on bar 80 with the song's own 3-beat drum hit = the reboot. Music fully out 3.92 s. If 2.94 s of silence tests long, the fallback cut is bar 78 beat 3 (152.40).

audio_edits.name: the outro: whisper over a fading pulse (her ask)
audio_edits.what: From bar 92 (178.83, after 'Take me back' ends 178.24) the full mix is replaced (one-beat crossfade) by: a pulse = the drum stem's kick (low-passed ~180 Hz) + the synth stem pad, fading from -10 dB at 178.83 to -30 dB by bar 100 (194.48); and the vocal stem's 'Undo.' (180.40, 186.00, 188.00), 'Perfect.' (194.64), 'Ship it.' (195.44) treated as a whisper (about -8 dB, high-pass 180 Hz, de-essed, a little air at 10 kHz, short dark room). The 'ho' ad-libs (~181.8, ~183.6) come out. The song's loud last hit (195.95-196.93, the loudest moment of the track) comes out. On bar 101 (196.44): one soft kick + one UI click (the cursor clicking the dot), then the pad alone to 198.00 at the opening pad's level (-31 dB at 0:00), so the audio loops into the first frame too. A true whisper can't be made from a sung take: the rough cut uses the treated stem; for the master a real whispered take of the five words is better (fork in the plan).

shots.title: s62 Make me feel like I'm on time (then the render chokes)
shots.lyric: Make me feel like I'm on time

sung.line: Make me feel like I'm on time

shots.text: › Make me feel like I'm on time · MEMORY 97% → 99%
shots.change: 'time' lands exactly on bar 77: every clock in the city snaps to the same time. Then the song drops its drums (149.95) and the render starts to choke: the fps readout falls 60 → 24 → 8 → 2, tiles re-render in blocks, the meter climbs to 99%.
shots.eggs: the clocks show 2:29, the film's real timecode. One frame before the crash a pigeon lands on the rooftop red button (the cause).

shots.title: s63 CRASH: dead silence
shots.text: no prompt typed; bar border turns red · MEMORY 100% red
shots.change: AUDIO EDIT E3: hard cut to digital silence on bar 78. The real scene fails: Blender wireframe, materials fall back to the true magenta checkerboard, debug labels pop in on the silent beats ('sun.mat — not found', 'ocean.tex — missing', 'city_lod3 — failed'). First time loud colour floods the screen.
shots.eggs: the log also lists 'pigeon.001 — pressed button'.
shots.notes: The labels land on the silent grid (bar 78 beat 3, bar 79 beat 1, bar 79 beat 3) so the pulse is felt without sound.

shots.title: s64 Out of memory. (sung in the silence) → reboot
shots.text: › Out of memory. (red bar, approved frame 4) · MEMORY 100%
shots.change: Her 'Out of memory.' alone in the silence (154.36); on bar 80 the music comes back with the song's own drum hit (the reboot): the crashed world shrinks to a card and the HISTORY panel opens.
shots.eggs: the history panel's last item is 'Out of memory.' in red.

shots.title: s65 Make it smaller
shots.text: › Make it smaller · MEMORY 88%
shots.change: The crashed world (as a card) shrinks to a thumbnail; the meter starts to fall.
shots.eggs: every thumbnail in the history panel is a real frame from the film.

shots.title: s66 Make it quiet
shots.text: › Make it quiet · MEMORY 80%
shots.change: The glitch labels and magenta fade out; the meter goes from red back to white.

shots.title: s67 Keep the beat and lose the riot
shots.lyric: Keep the beat and lose the riot

sung.line: Keep the beat and lose the riot

shots.text: › Keep the beat and lose the riot · MEMORY 64%
shots.change: Everything but the dot files away into the history panel; the pink dot is back, breathing on the kick.

shots.title: s68 Just the dot, just the dark
shots.lyric: Just the dot, just the dark

sung.line: Just the dot, just the dark

shots.text: › Just the dot, just the dark · MEMORY 56%
shots.change: The dot grid fades: only the dark and the dot.

shots.title: s69 Just a little beating heart / Make it smaller
shots.lyric: Just a little beating heart / Make it smaller
shots.text: › Just a little beating heart → › Make it smaller · MEMORY 50%
shots.change: Grouped (both land on bar 86): the dot shrinks to half and its breath turns into a heartbeat (lub-dub on 1 and the 'and' of 1).

shots.title: s70 Make it simple
shots.text: › Make it simple · MEMORY 46%
shots.change: The UI simplifies: history panel slides off, only the bar, the meter and the dot.

shots.title: s71 One white light against the black
shots.lyric: One white light against the black

sung.line: One white light against the black

shots.text: › One white light against the black · MEMORY 44%
shots.change: On 'light' (bar 88) the pink dot turns white: the only time it changes colour.
shots.eggs: the REC dot by the meter turns white too.

shots.title: s72 Run it, run it (typed with no voice)

sung.timing_source: NOT SUNG: no vocal 172.65-175.90 (vocal stem + MIDI + backing stem all empty)

shots.text: › Run it, run it (typed by itself, on the beat) · MEMORY 43%
shots.change: She doesn't sing this line (bars 89-90 have no vocal). The bar types it by itself, a word per beat, no human cursor; the white light pulses twice (bar 89, bar 90).
shots.eggs: the only prompt in the film nobody says out loud.

shots.title: s73 Take me back
shots.text: › Take me back · MEMORY 41%
shots.change: The HISTORY panel opens again on the right; the world's pieces (moons, the car, buildings, pigeons) reappear around the white dot, drifting.

shots.title: s74 Undo. (1)
shots.text: › Undo. · MEMORY 41% → 28% (approved frame 5)
shots.change: AUDIO EDIT E4 from bar 92: whisper over a fading pulse. On bar 93 the history highlight jumps up a block; the outer pieces spiral into the dot (frame-5 look).
shots.eggs: the highlighted history line is the prompt whose world is being sucked in.

shots.title: s75 Undo. (2)

shots.title: s76 Undo. (3)

shots.title: s77 Perfect.
shots.text: › Perfect. · MEMORY 1%
shots.change: The history panel closes. Stillness: the white light, the bar. For one beat the empty bar shows a grey autocomplete suggestion: '› subscribe' (the film's subscribe ask, in-world; 34 px+).
shots.eggs: the suggestion is the only prompt the model ever proposes to her.

shots.title: s78 Ship it. → the click → New session (loop)
shots.text: › Ship it. · MEMORY 0% (approved frame 6)
shots.change: On bar 101 the cursor clicks the white dot (the only sound effect in the film: one soft click): the dot was the button all along. The white light blooms to fill the frame and becomes the white page of frame 0: the video loops seamlessly into 'New session.'
shots.eggs: the REC clock stops at 03:18 and reads 'shipped'.
shots.notes: The last frame must equal the first frame.
